purpose: Two transparent mushroom and mycelium colonies for the Agent hero background
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent illustration sprite for the animated background of the Mycellios Agent website. Use the supplied image ONLY as the style reference: intricate antique engraving, stippled botanical detail, ivory porous mycelium and anatomically convincing oyster mushrooms. Do not include any computers or hardware.
Create ONE wide 3:2 image on a genuinely transparent background containing TWO SEPARATE complete mushroom colonies, one in the left half and one in the right half. They will be displayed as independent side decorations; keep every colony fully inside its own half, with at least 8% transparent air between the two groups and transparent space at all outer edges. No panels, divider, labels, ground rectangle or text.
Left colony: a dramatic tall arrangement of 6–8 mushrooms, large broad ivory and warm golden caps, exquisitely detailed undersides and gills, elegant twisting stalks, and a dense branching lattice of pale mycelium rising from exposed woodland roots. The cap silhouettes must be unmistakably mushrooms, bold and richly sculptural. Right colony: a DIFFERENT asymmetric arrangement, several broad overlapping oyster/fan mushrooms with one taller bonnet mushroom and a curling, porous mycelial root network. The two colonies should have a similar height but clearly different silhouettes.
Match the reference's engraved and stippled craft, with dramatic depth and fine hatching. Cream, muted amber and parchment highlights, dark forest green ink and mossy details; some crisp pale mint threads in the mycelium. Strong luminous ivory edge details that will stand out against a near-black website, but no diffuse glow or haze. Richer and more striking than a simple line drawing. Plants are fungal roots and a small amount of moss only. Fully transparent between all stems and branches. Do not render a background, shadow floor, colored backdrop, fog, letters, UI, frames, machinery, people, skulls, or psychedelic neon. These are final high-detail botanical assets, not icons, a logo, or a mockup.
